[[Langmar's Defender]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. 
==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +16  (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:Tactics  +1 (Chance: 20% while using [[skill]]s)
:[[Health]] +30 

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Signet Shield]] and [[Shield of Purity]].

==Replica==
Except for visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is an [[Adamantine Shield]] from crafter [[Keeper of Arms]].

It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Shield of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Shield Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "Master of My Domain" [[inscription]]

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following Tactics shields:
**[[Ornate Buckler]] from collector [[Kaplack]]
**[[Round Shield]] from collector [[Fopp]]
**[[Destroyer Shield]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Shield]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Shield]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*Perfect "Master of My Domain" inscription
OR
*One of the following Tactics shields:
**[[Adamantine Shield]] from crafter [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Shield]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Shield]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Shield]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Shield]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Shield]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Shield of the Wing]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Turai's Shield]] from [[Durmand]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Charr Shield]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Mursaat Shield]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Shield]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Shield]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*Perfect [[Shield Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "Master of My Domain" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
*[[Tarnen's Shield]] and [[Sharptooth's Shield]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Reefclaw's Refuge]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Strength]].

==Notes==
*As the name would suggest, this shield is a replica of the one [[Captain Langmar]] wields.
